name: app.restophoto/food-photo-studio
title: RestoPhoto Food Photo Studio
description: Delivery photo specs and dish photo style guidance for restaurants on Uber Eats, Wolt and menus.

tools.name: get_delivery_photo_specs
tools.description: Use this when looking up exact recommended pixel dimensions, aspect ratios, minimum resolutions, and square-crop rules for restaurant menu photos on Uber Eats, DoorDash, Wolt, Deliveroo, Glovo, Bolt Food, Pyszne.pl, Lieferando, Just Eat, Grubhub, and Seamless. Do not use to audit a specific photo file: use check_delivery_photo_compliance for that.

platforms.description: Optional list of delivery platforms to look up. Omit or pass ['all'] for all 11 platforms.

tools.name: check_delivery_photo_compliance
tools.description: Use this when auditing a restaurant dish photo (via public HTTPS image_url or explicit width/height pixel dimensions) for Uber Eats, DoorDash, Wolt, Deliveroo, Glovo, Bolt Food, Pyszne.pl, or Lieferando readiness. Calculates exact crop loss, upscaling factor, published minimum compliance, square-crop safe zones, and (for URLs) optical sharpness and brightness scores. Do not use for non-food graphics or private authenticated image URLs.

image_url.description: Public HTTP/HTTPS URL of a dish photo (JPEG, PNG, or WebP, max 10 MB).

width.description: Image width in pixels (use when no public image_url is provided).

height.description: Image height in pixels (use when no public image_url is provided).

format.description: Optional image format (JPEG, PNG, WEBP) when passing dimensions.

file_size_kb.description: Optional file size in KB when passing dimensions (checks Bolt Food 100 KB floor and 10 MB cap).

platforms.description: Target delivery apps to check. Defaults to uber, doordash, wolt, deliveroo, glovo.

tools.name: recommend_dish_photo_styles
tools.description: Use this when a restaurant owner, marketer, or food stylist asks how to photograph or style a specific dish (for example burger, Neapolitan pizza, ramen, sushi, cocktail, dessert, kebab) for delivery menus, Instagram, printed menus, or websites. Applies RestoPhoto's tall-dish camera angle rules and hard-light style catalog. Do not use to verify image dimensions or crop ratios: use check_delivery_photo_compliance instead.

dish.description: Dish name or brief description (e.g. 'double smashburger', 'margherita pizza', 'tonkotsu ramen').

goal.description: Primary destination channel for the dish photo.

locale.description: Language for style preset names and descriptions.
